sections.title: Learners needing contact
sections.sql: select learner,trainer,quiet_days,overdue_results from enrolment_board where status='active' and quiet_days>=14

sections.title: Assessments to review
sections.sql: select learner,unit,outcome,due_on,trainer from assessment_queue where outcome in ('pending','not-yet-competent')

sections.title: Balances by currency
sections.sql: select currency,sum(balance_cents) as balance_cents from fee_balances where balance_cents>0 group by currency

sections.title: Overdue invoices
sections.sql: select learner,invoice,currency,balance_cents,due_on from fee_balances where balance_cents>0 and due_on<current_date

sections.title: Credential review
sections.sql: select learner,jurisdiction,review_due_on,identity_recorded,fees_confirmed from certificate_queue where credential is null
